senses.gloss:
ऐश्वर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ईश्वर), fit for or belong-
ing to or produced by a master, or by the supreme
lord; mighty, majestic; divine, relating to God;
supreme, royal; belonging to Śiva.
ऐश्वरिक, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) a theist.

ऐश्वर्य, अम्, n. power, might, sway; dominion;
supremacy; superhuman power; the divine faculties
of omnipresence, omnipotence, invisibility, &c. (some-
times their number is given as five, with reference to
the five elements).
—ऐश्वर्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, en-
dowed with superhuman faculties, possessed of super-
natural powers, connected with them.
